text:
samir: FYI bringing up Cascade-13B (Llama-style FF + Mistral attn mix). converter finished, int8 dynamic quant used for smoke. longchat QA is hallucinating facts mid-doc.
maya: stats?
samir: on longdocs (3k tokens) answer accuracy down ~18% vs fp16 baseline; rouge/bleu both tank. short QA fine.
liam: could be rotary scaling or tokenizer differences. Cascade has per-block rotary_scale in model card. converter ignored unknown fields.
jorge: did converter emit any hints?
samir: small snips from converter log: 
```
INFO: exporting attention -> shape (24,128,64)
WARNING: inferred_head_stride=2 (possible interleaved layout)
WARNING: unknown_metadata: rotary_scale_per_block ignored
```

nora: inferred_head_stride=2 often means exporter interleaved heads (eg head0 from groupA, head0 from groupB ...). If converter flattens without permuting, kv/proj order mismatches and rotary indices align wrong.
maya: we saw a similar smell last month. Quick check: per-head cosine similarity between fp16 and int8 attn proj outputs: layers 12-15 show mean 0.78, others >0.98.
liam: that points to head shuffle rather than quant noise. but hallucination growth with position suggests rotary mismatch too. Any per-layer rotary params in source?
samir: model card includes: "rotary_scale": [1.0,...], and block_meta: [{"layer":12, "scale":0.5}, {"layer":13, "scale":0.5}] but converter dropped block_meta.
jorge: aha. scale=0.5 means those layers use half-frequency -> phase doubles every position. If we used 1.0 everywhere, the phase drift grows with pos.
nora: also check tokenizer normalization. I saw Cascade's tokenizer uses NFKC + pretoken normalization that collapses certain zero-width joiners. If converter uses standard tokenizer mapping it's possible BOS/EOS/sentinel token ids differ for long sequences assembled by pipeline.
maya: I ran a quick token id diff on a long doc. Most ids matched but there are subtle extra splits on diacritics around position ~900 which shifts subsequent positions by +1 occasionally. That can amplify rope misalignment effects.
liam: so multi-hit: head stride + missing rotary_scale + token split -> compounding errors.
samir: quick experiments: 1) permuting heads to contiguous ordering recovered short context answers 2) injecting per-block rotary_scale for layers 12/13 improved coherence up to 85% of baseline 3) fixing tokenizer normalization restored token alignment but still ~7% gap.
jorge: the remaining delta could be int8 quant granularity. dynamic int8 is noisy on small-scale rotary projections. Try per-channel symmetric quant for attn q/k/v/out and calibration on a longctx sample.
nora: Agreed. Also add small regression test: synthetic doc with repeated unicode ligatures + long summary target; detect token id shifts >0.1% and flag.
maya: Implementation plan: a) patch converter to honor block_meta.rotary_scale and to compute canonical head permutation when inferred_head_stride!=1 b) update tokenizer ingestion to run upstream normalizer (NFKC+ZWNJ handling) c) add int8 per-channel calibration option in quant tool d) add kv_cosine and token_alignment checks in preflight.
liam: +1. For rollout, canary on Dedicated, 5% traffic, synthetic longctx probes every 10s. Add automatic rollback if accuracy drops >5% over 30m.
ora: Also add logging: when head permutation applied, emit mapping table and a checksum of permuted tensors so runtime can verify mapping at load time.
ciabot: samir opened PR "cascade/rotary-scale-headperm-tokennorm" (4 commits). CI queued.
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy to eng-dedicated at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z (model:cascade-13b:v1-canary) routing 5% traffic. rollback policy: accuracy delta >5% for 30m.
samir: I'll land the converter patch and run a calibration sweep tomorrow morning. will upload calibration logs to the model registry.
maya: I'll draft the token-alignment regression and add it to onboarding checklist.
liam: happy to run the per-channel int8 sweep with you.
samir: thanks all. will report back after canary.
